spec.description:
Bradford Gold Hi-Performance Batts (Gold HP) are high-density,
top-tier glasswool insulation batts engineered to deliver maximum thermal
resistance within standard residential and commercial cavities. Available in
industry-leading ratings up to R7.0 for ceilings and R2.7 HP for 90mm walls,
they allow builders and homeowners in extreme Australian climate zones to meet
stringent 7-star and 8-star energy efficiency standards without increasing
framing depths. Featuring Comfort Touch technology, they are non-combustible,
low-allergen, Sensitive Choice certified, and backed by a 70-year performance
warranty.
features:
Maximum thermal R-value per millimetre of cavity
thickness

Industry-leading ceiling ratings: R4.1 HP, R5.0 HP, R6.0 HP, and
R7.0 HP

High-density wall batts: R2.0 HP (75mm), R2.2 HP (75mm), R2.5 HP
(90mm), and R2.7 HP (90mm)

Gold Perimeter Batts available in R3.0 (100mm
low-profile) for tight eave zones

Manufactured with up to 80% recycled glass
content

Enhanced acoustic density dampens environmental noise and rain
noise

Low-itch Comfort Touch technology for cleaner handling and reduced
dust
Water-repellent treatment on wall batts prevents moisture absorption
Non-combustible when tested in accordance with AS 1530.1

Backed by CSR
Bradford's 70-year product performance warranty

Non-combustible to
AS 1530.1; AS/NZS 1530.3: Ignitability 0, Spread of Flame 0, Heat Evolved 0,

spec.compliance: AS/NZS 4859.1, AS 3999, NCC 2022 / NCC 2025 7-star NatHERS compliance
spec.sustainability:
Contains up to 80% recycled glass; bio-soluble FBS-1; zero
ODP; Sensitive Choice certified
install:
Isolate power at the main
switchboard before entering ceiling or working in wall cavities

Fit HP batts
friction-tight between studs or ceiling joists with zero gaps

Ensure
high-density wall batts remain flat without bulging plasterboard or breaching
outer cavity space

Use R3.0 low-profile Gold Perimeter Batts around roof
eaves to avoid compression within 450mm of external walls

Maintain required
clearances from non-IC downlights and flues per AS 3999
selection_checklist:
Check NatHERS energy rating report for exact required
R-values (e.g. R2.7 in walls, R5.0 or R6.0 in ceiling)

Confirm wall stud
depth (75mm for 70mm studs; 90mm for 90mm studs)

Verify stud and joist
spacing (430mm for 450mm centres, 580mm for 600mm centres)

Check eave height
clearance to determine if Gold Perimeter Batts are needed
limitations:
Do not force thicker batts into shallower stud
cavities as plasterboard will bulge

Must be kept dry during transport,
storage, and installation
Must not cover non-IC rated electrical fixtures

problem_keywords:
extreme roof heat in alpine or
desert climate
maximum thermal efficiency for new build
use_cases:
Insulating external 90mm stud walls with R2.7
HP batts to achieve 7-star energy compliance without changing frame thickness

Installing R5.0 to R7.0 HP batts in ceilings of alpine, cold climate, or hot
tropical homes

Using low-profile R3.0 Perimeter Batts to maintain compliant
ceiling insulation depth at roof eaves
not_for:
Direct masonry contact
without cavity wrap
retrieval.rag_summary:
Bradford Gold Hi-Performance Batts (Gold
HP) represent CSR Bradford's highest-density glasswool insulation range,
engineered to provide maximum thermal resistance in space-constrained building
cavities. Offering ceiling ratings from R4.1 HP up to R7.0 HP and wall ratings
up to R2.7 HP in standard 90mm studs, it is the premier solution for
achieving 7-star and 8-star NatHERS energy compliance across Australia.
Non-combustible to AS 1530.1, Sensitive Choice certified, and formulated with
low-itch Comfort Touch technology, it provides lifetime thermal and acoustic
performance backed by a 70-year warranty.
